goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse-Labs/.github single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a correctly owned replaceable always-on host whose writable SHWP state survives restart and deploy without transferring heartbeat scheduling authority to the host provider.
success_predicates: Dedicated master-records host and durable state resource exist
Recurring infrastructure and provisioning authority are durably approved
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt and canonical-checkpoint state survive restart/deploy
Host runs the canonical runtime continuously while runtime v8 owns internal cadence
Restart-continuity proof preserves or increments the one heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No ChatGPT automation, GitHub schedule, Render cron or equivalent external scheduler owns worker activation
failure_predicates: A stateless or sleeping host is presented as durable always-on activation
A third-party scheduler becomes the normative heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Restart/deploy loses or forks canonical heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt or checkpoint state

task.derivation_reason: Human provisioning authority is resolved and dedicated resources exist; only provider build-capacity execution and restart proof remain.

terminal_when: The dedicated compliant host is active with durable SHWP state
Parent StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 activation predicates are all satisfied
